## Deliverables

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `index.html` | Entry shell loading `styles.css` and `styleguide.js` |
| `styleguide.js` | Imports real `src/` modules; wires overview, setup, and inspection with shared receipt state |
| `styles.css` | Full visual system (tokens + board, winners, ticket counter, responsive layout) |
| `system-decisions.json` | `promote`, `prune`, `keepLocal` ledger |
| `src/` | Extended browser modules + `assets/stars.svg` |

## Behavior

**Overview** — `Overview()` renders live pot (`Ξ 553`), demo wallet status, and `PastWinners()` ledger on the red field.

**Ticket setup** — `Setup()` composes:
- `LotteryBoard` — pointer + keyboard (arrows, Space/Enter), exactly-five gating, SUBMIT disabled until 5 punched
- ROLL deterministically selects **3, 12, 19, 27, 44** (with shuffle animation; instant under `prefers-reduced-motion`)
- `TicketCounter` — 1–10 range with upstream labels (`counter 01`, `max 10 per wallet approval`)
- Wallet approval — Approve/Reject updates receipt state locally

**Receipt inspection** — `Inspection()` updates on pending, approve (`TicketEntered`), or reject (`approval rejected`) with numbers and ticket count.

## System decisions (also rendered in the styleguide)

- **promote → `StatusMark`** (`src/components.js`) — repeated compact status markup unified
- **prune → null** — no upstream shared JS export to remove (per brief evidence)
- **keepLocal → `LotteryBoard`** (`src/lottery-board.js`) — owns selection rules, roll, keyboard, submit gating

## Visual grammar preserved

Ink-black borders, off-white/red paper slips, yellow kickers, stamped headings, imperfect rotation, punched-slip animations, and board status strip — not flattened into a neutral dashboard. Responsive at 390px and 1440px; focus-visible outlines on interactive elements.
